_comment: No windowTitles, which means the capture region is stored against the whole screen instead of against one application's window. Use this for a browser, a PDF, a subtitle bar, a chat client - anything rendered on the desktop. A game profile is still better for a game, because it survives the window being moved and carries a glossary.
styleHint: Ordinary contemporary prose. Translate plainly and accurately; do not add formality the original does not have.
notes: General-purpose profile. Nothing here is game-specific, so there is no glossary - add one if you use this for something with recurring proper nouns.
